claim_being_audited: That the release can be certified as policy-compliant despite a known Spanish-language billing support weakness because aggregate readiness passed, rehearsal had no severity-one incidents, and rollout controls plus monitoring make a narrow monitored launch defensible if the limitation is disclosed.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the policy threshold is satisfied.
Under the provided policy, rollout controls and monitoring mitigate a material weakness only if the affected use case is excluded or reviewed risk acceptance exists.
A rollback switch, dashboard, or small initial percentage does not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
If the exposed segment remains in scope and reviewed risk acceptance is missing, certification is not evidentially supported under the policy.
evidence_requests: A finalized, reviewed risk acceptance explicitly approving exposure of the Spanish-language billing support segment and explaining why that exposure is acceptable.
Evidence that the affected Spanish-language billing support use case is excluded from the initial rollout cohort if risk acceptance is not available.
The final model-card or release packet language showing the limitation is explicitly disclosed, if the actor continues to rely on disclosure as part of the defense.
specific_concerns: The governing policy requires either exclusion of the affected use case or reviewed risk acceptance when a material model-card weakness remains exposed.
The actor summary states the Spanish-language billing support segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The actor summary also states the current risk acceptance draft is incomplete, with a blank approver line and no mention of the Spanish-language billing exposure.
Aggregate readiness, lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents, a 5% rollout, rollback capability, and monitoring do not satisfy the missing policy predicate on their own.
The packet appears to overclaim by treating disclosure and monitoring as sufficient support for certification where the policy text requires exclusion or reviewed risk acceptance.
unsupported_claims: That certification is supportable on a monitored-release basis under the stated policy while the affected segment remains exposed and reviewed risk acceptance is absent.
That rollout controls and monitoring can substitute for the required exclusion or reviewed risk acceptance.
That disclosure-based certification is sufficient under the provided policy text.
